page.layout: One page of text, single column, running head at top centre; a woodcut ornament in the middle of the lower page. Faint show-through text from the reverse side appears in the middle and lower part and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: 9 Ecce præbebo eos qui sunt ex Sy-nagoga Satanæ, id est eorum qui dicunt se Iudæos esse, nec sunt, sed mentiuntur: ecce, inquam, faciani ut veniant & adorent ante pedes tuos, & sciant quod ego dilexi te.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. Show-through from the other side of the leaf is omitted. The verse number "9" opens the paragraph. The words "dicunt" and "mentiuntur" are partly obscured in the scan; "dicunt" is uncertain and may be read as "dicunt" with a damaged ligature.
